SELECT a.* FROM article a WHERE a.state = '已发布'
AND MATCH(a.title, a.content) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
AND (a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
SELECT a.* FROM article a WHERE a.state = '已发布' AND FIND_IN_SET(#{tag}, a.tags) > 0 ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
